name: SISSA  -  International School for Advanced Studies, Trieste
header:
SISSA - International School for Advanced
Studies, Trieste
Italy · PhD in Geometry and Mathematical Physics (GMP)
Curated European option; no numerical ranking asserted
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• A four-year BA can be considered only through foreign-degree equivalence; do not assume automatic direct
PhD eligibility.
• Do not use the old FAQ’s March deadline or old net funding figures for the new GMP cycle.
• Current public sources disagree on one versus two references; prepare two and obtain confirmation.
• Pavlo Gavrylenko’s ordinary SISSA affiliation appears stale; Birmingham is supported by current sources.
• SISSA’s core fit is algebraic/complex geometry and representation-theoretic mathematical physics;
arithmetic and number theory are less directly represented.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Conflict]
Conditional direct-bachelor possibility: the legal call requires a master’s or suitable foreign equivalent; FAQ
says a degree allowing PhD entry in its home system, often a four-year BSc/Hons, may qualify, subject to
institutional assessment. UChicago’s four-year mathematics BA therefore merits a specific equivalence inquiry;
it is not automatically approved. No age/citizenship restriction in the 2026 call; qualifying degree due by
enrolment. [s2] [s4]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Request foreign-degree eligibility clarification; select GMP’s actual call in PICA, prepare signed application and
uploads, arrange professors’ institutional email addresses, and check the specific selection sheet. Faculty
contact is encouraged for research fit but no pre-application supervisor commitment is listed. The old FAQ’s
separate non-EU preselection should not be assumed for 2027. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s4]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Central admissions explicitly encourages discussion with a relevant PI. No prior binding supervisor acceptance
is listed for GMP. Prior selection: qualifications 30 points (21 minimum), remote oral 70 points; minimum 7/10
equivalent in each phase. Faculty shortlist below covers closest AG/complex/representation matches; no strong
dedicated arithmetic/number-theory group established. [s1] [s3] [s7]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Use PICA: create/select correct application, save drafts, upload PDFs, complete signature and Submit. Linked
guide promises delivery email with application ID and protocol email; saving is not submission. A submitted
application requires withdrawal/new submission for edits under that guide. [s2] [s5]
Cycle verification [Prior cycle]
No explicit 2027-28 call found. Current central page remains 2026-27; GMP’s prior January 2026 deadline has
passed. All prior amounts/dates above are labelled; monitor the new call rather than extrapolating them. [s1]
[s2] [s3]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [Prior cycle]
2027-28 deadline not published. Prior GMP cycle: 19 January 2026, 13:00 Italian time, for 1 October 2026
entry; oral examination 23-27 February 2026 remotely. The call website’s general 'open until December'
display is not the GMP application deadline. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Funding consideration [Prior cycle]
SISSA-funded GMP places were awarded through the same admission competition; prior 19 January 2026
deadline. Eight fellowships in that cycle. No 2027 fellowship count/date established; separately advertised
project positions have their own calls. [s1] [s3]
Reference receipt [Prior cycle]
Current legal call permits completion of the reference procedure within two days after the course closing date.
For prior GMP this implies 21 January 2026 by calendar arithmetic; a separate reference cutoff hour is not
explicitly published. No 2027 deadline established. [s2] [s3]
Test-score receipt [Unresolved]
No mandatory GRE/English-score deadline in the current call. Old FAQ welcomes optional certificates; any
optional upload should accompany the application unless the actual 2027 call says otherwise. No separate
late-score rule established. [s2] [s4]
Supporting documents [Prior cycle]
Applicant uploads/signature must be completed by the course deadline. Qualifying degree must exist at
enrolment, which must be finalised by the end of the course’s starting month; prior GMP start 1 October 2026.
No 2027 document grace date published. [s2] [s3]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
Offer notification is by email; a universal acceptance-response interval was not found. Prior 2026 call requires
arrival by 1 October for mathematics unless an adequate justification is accepted, otherwise place/funding are
forfeited. The offer’s acceptance deadline must be checked separately. [s2]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
Scientific/teaching activities are in English and Italian is not required according to the FAQ. TOEFL/IELTS or
other certificates are described as non-mandatory but welcome; current 2026 legal call lists no compulsory
English test or minimum score. Confirm the 2027 call rather than relying on the obsolete parts of the FAQ. [s2]
[s4]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
No UChicago-specific waiver is needed under the published non-mandatory-test approach, but no separate
automatic US-degree exemption policy is stated. The English UChicago record can support language
preparation; interview/committee assessment remains relevant. [s2] [s4]
GRE General [Conflict]
Not required in the legal checklist. The old FAQ jointly mentions GRE with English certificates as
non-mandatory/welcome, without a clear General-vs-Subject distinction. Do not read this as a current explicit
GRE recommendation. [s2] [s4]
GRE Mathematics [Unresolved]
Not required in the legal checklist; no specific Mathematics Subject Test policy, score threshold, consideration
weight or upload prohibition established. Generic old FAQ GRE language does not resolve the subject-test
category. [s2] [s4]

sections.title: Academic records
sections.text:
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Upload academic CV, record of all previous university examinations/grades, degree evidence if already
awarded, master’s thesis or abstract, and ID. Italian-university certificates are replaced by self-certification
under the call; confirm the appropriate official foreign-record format for UChicago. FAQ accepts university
documents in English, French, Spanish or German. [s2] [s4]
Mathematics-course list [Unresolved]
All examinations and grades are required; no additional standardized mathematics-only list found. Include
complete academic records and check whether PICA asks further course metadata. [s2]
Course descriptions [Unresolved]
No separate syllabus/course-description packet is requested in the current legal checklist. The
foreign-equivalence inquiry may require additional clarification, but no prescribed format was found. [s2] [s4]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Conflict]
Conflicting public descriptions: current legal call says up to two professors; student wiki says at least one
reference; old FAQ says two. Arrange two professors and ask admissions to confirm the mandatory 2027
minimum. No basis to treat zero letters as safe. [s2] [s4] [s6]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
Ordinary SISSA fellowship consideration is integrated with admission, without a separate scholarship
referee/essay in the legal call. External project awards may differ; inspect their own conditions. [s2] [s3]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Legal call places referee entry after completion/signing of the application; institutional email details then
generate a platform request to upload the recommendation. Merely saving a draft before submission is not
established as an invitation trigger. [s2]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
The current call describes reference requests subsequently to the signed admission request. Submit early
enough to activate them; public instructions do not establish a method to request letters from an unfinished
draft. [s2]
Receipt confirmation [Unresolved]
PICA instructions confirm application delivery/protocol emails, not individual referee receipt. A letter receipt
indicator/email was not established in SISSA’s public guide; verify in the actual portal. [s5]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
The linked PICA guide says submitted applications cannot be edited: withdraw/reapply before the deadline;
draft editing is allowed. It does not specify whether letters transfer, can be replaced or can be reused across
calls. Confirm before withdrawing an application with letters. [s5]

sections.title: Written materials
sections.text:
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Required academic CV, uploaded as non-editable electronic document/PDF. No specific prompt beyond
academic history, page count, font or margin limit in current call. Old FAQ lists 8 MB/file and 20 MB total, but
those limits require 2027 PICA confirmation. [s2] [s4] [s5]
Statement of purpose [Unresolved]
No separate statement of purpose is listed in the current GMP/legal checklist. Do not invent an upload

requirement or assume an unlisted optional essay is accepted. Any 2027 portal-only prompt/limit remains
unverified. [s2] [s3]
Personal / background statement [Unresolved]
No separate personal/background statement found in current legal/GMP requirements; prompt, limit and
upload permission unestablished. [s2] [s3]
Research-interest statement [Unresolved]
Research fit is assessed through qualifications and oral examination; no standalone research-interest
statement is listed. Faculty contact can clarify relevant projects. Any portal text-box prompt/length is not
public. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
No research proposal is requested in the general/GMP 2026 admission lists. A later PhD research project is part
of study, not evidence of a pre-application proposal requirement. Check the 2027 call for changes. [s2] [s3]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
Required master’s thesis OR abstract in non-editable upload/PDF. No abstract word/page limit published. A BA
applicant seeking equivalence must ask whether an undergraduate thesis or research summary is the
accepted substitute. [s2]
Publications list [Unresolved]
No standalone publications-list mandate. Old FAQ permits relevant thesis/poster/other-document uploads, but
current PICA allowance and limits need checking. Describe publications in CV; do not assume papers may be
linked instead of uploaded. [s2] [s4]
Course-list document [Unresolved]
No separate course-list statement requested; all examination records/grades are part of the academic-record
requirement. Template, syllabus attachment and length not published. [s2]
Scholarship essays [Standing rule]
No separate ordinary SISSA scholarship essay; funding accompanies selection. For an externally
sponsored/restricted award, follow its own call, which may impose project-specific material. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Other short answers / materials [Conflict]
Print/sign and re-upload the admission request as directed by the current call/PICA signature method; upload
ID. The linked technical guide requires PDF. Old FAQ’s email/paper procedure is superseded by the current
PICA call. [s2] [s4] [s5]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
Prior 2026-27 call: €16,242.96 annually before INPS deductions, for the course duration. Additional benefits:
relocation €1,000 if domiciled outside Europe or €500 in EU; eligible registered Trieste rental €150
gross/month; laptop reimbursement up to €400; eligible health insurance reimbursement up to €700/year;
later-year career-development up to €1,000 and qualifying non-EU home-travel up to €500. These are
conditional benefits, not guaranteed net salary. [s2]
Years of support [Prior cycle]
Four-year PhD and scholarship, with possible completion after year three; annual progression/examinations
condition continuation. 2027-28 terms not yet published. [s2]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
The call expressly welcomes all citizenships; ordinary SISSA awards are not restricted to EU applicants. Non-EU
status may qualify for specified insurance/travel support, subject to the exact rules. Visa/Italian residence steps
are separate from US F-1 status. [s1] [s2]

Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Scholarship is subject to INPS deductions and satisfactory progression; housing supplement requires a
registered rental in Trieste province away from family home. Health/laptop/travel benefits require evidence
and specified eligibility. Prior annual regional student tax €120-€160 is payable for enrolment/funding. [s2]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
No separate general-fellowship application listed beyond PhD competition. Housing, insurance, laptop and
travel reimbursements require their own requests/evidence after admission. [s2]
Other funding routes [Conflict]
Central admission page advertises separately funded project fellowships; no matching additional 2027 GMP call
verified. Old FAQ welcomes external scholarships and describes SISSA top-ups, but its €1,120 net figure is
dated and not a reliable current guarantee. [s1] [s4]
Application fee [Unresolved]
No application fee amount is stated in the checked call/PICA instructions; do not label it free from silence.
Regional enrolment tax is separate: prior €120-€160/year. No 2027 tuition/tax schedule confirmed. [s2] [s5]
Fee waiver [Unresolved]
No application-fee waiver procedure or UChicago/F-1 entitlement found. Regional-tax relief follows ARDIS rules;
a waiver should not be assumed from admission or international status. [s2]

sections.text:
Algebraic / arithmetic geometry
Barbara Fantechi
Algebraic stacks, deformation/obstruction theory, moduli of sheaves and enumerative geometry. [s7] [s10]
Professor. New-student availability in 2027 unconfirmed.

Enumerative invariants of sheaf moduli, Hilbert/Quot schemes, motives, derived categories and

text:
SISSA - International School for Advanced
Studies, Trieste
Italy · PhD in Geometry and Mathematical Physics (GMP)
Curated European option; no numerical ranking asserted
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• A four-year BA can be considered only through foreign-degree equivalence; do not assume automatic direct
PhD eligibility.
• Do not use the old FAQ’s March deadline or old net funding figures for the new GMP cycle.
• Current public sources disagree on one versus two references; prepare two and obtain confirmation.
• Pavlo Gavrylenko’s ordinary SISSA affiliation appears stale; Birmingham is supported by current sources.
• SISSA’s core fit is algebraic/complex geometry and representation-theoretic mathematical physics;
arithmetic and number theory are less directly represented.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Conflict]
Conditional direct-bachelor possibility: the legal call requires a master’s or suitable foreign equivalent; FAQ
says a degree allowing PhD entry in its home system, often a four-year BSc/Hons, may qualify, subject to
institutional assessment. UChicago’s four-year mathematics BA therefore merits a specific equivalence inquiry;
it is not automatically approved. No age/citizenship restriction in the 2026 call; qualifying degree due by
enrolment. [s2] [s4]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Request foreign-degree eligibility clarification; select GMP’s actual call in PICA, prepare signed application and
uploads, arrange professors’ institutional email addresses, and check the specific selection sheet. Faculty
contact is encouraged for research fit but no pre-application supervisor commitment is listed. The old FAQ’s
separate non-EU preselection should not be assumed for 2027. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s4]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Central admissions explicitly encourages discussion with a relevant PI. No prior binding supervisor acceptance
is listed for GMP. Prior selection: qualifications 30 points (21 minimum), remote oral 70 points; minimum 7/10
equivalent in each phase. Faculty shortlist below covers closest AG/complex/representation matches; no strong
dedicated arithmetic/number-theory group established. [s1] [s3] [s7]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Use PICA: create/select correct application, save drafts, upload PDFs, complete signature and Submit. Linked
guide promises delivery email with application ID and protocol email; saving is not submission. A submitted
application requires withdrawal/new submission for edits under that guide. [s2] [s5]
Cycle verification [Prior cycle]
No explicit 2027-28 call found. Current central page remains 2026-27; GMP’s prior January 2026 deadline has
passed. All prior amounts/dates above are labelled; monitor the new call rather than extrapolating them. [s1]
[s2] [s3]

Deadlines by stage
Academic application [Prior cycle]
2027-28 deadline not published. Prior GMP cycle: 19 January 2026, 13:00 Italian time, for 1 October 2026
entry; oral examination 23-27 February 2026 remotely. The call website’s general 'open until December'
display is not the GMP application deadline. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Funding consideration [Prior cycle]
SISSA-funded GMP places were awarded through the same admission competition; prior 19 January 2026
deadline. Eight fellowships in that cycle. No 2027 fellowship count/date established; separately advertised
project positions have their own calls. [s1] [s3]
Reference receipt [Prior cycle]
Current legal call permits completion of the reference procedure within two days after the course closing date.
For prior GMP this implies 21 January 2026 by calendar arithmetic; a separate reference cutoff hour is not
explicitly published. No 2027 deadline established. [s2] [s3]
Test-score receipt [Unresolved]
No mandatory GRE/English-score deadline in the current call. Old FAQ welcomes optional certificates; any
optional upload should accompany the application unless the actual 2027 call says otherwise. No separate
late-score rule established. [s2] [s4]
Supporting documents [Prior cycle]
Applicant uploads/signature must be completed by the course deadline. Qualifying degree must exist at
enrolment, which must be finalised by the end of the course’s starting month; prior GMP start 1 October 2026.
No 2027 document grace date published. [s2] [s3]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
Offer notification is by email; a universal acceptance-response interval was not found. Prior 2026 call requires
arrival by 1 October for mathematics unless an adequate justification is accepted, otherwise place/funding are
forfeited. The offer’s acceptance deadline must be checked separately. [s2]
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
Scientific/teaching activities are in English and Italian is not required according to the FAQ. TOEFL/IELTS or
other certificates are described as non-mandatory but welcome; current 2026 legal call lists no compulsory
English test or minimum score. Confirm the 2027 call rather than relying on the obsolete parts of the FAQ. [s2]
[s4]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
No UChicago-specific waiver is needed under the published non-mandatory-test approach, but no separate
automatic US-degree exemption policy is stated. The English UChicago record can support language
preparation; interview/committee assessment remains relevant. [s2] [s4]
GRE General [Conflict]
Not required in the legal checklist. The old FAQ jointly mentions GRE with English certificates as
non-mandatory/welcome, without a clear General-vs-Subject distinction. Do not read this as a current explicit
GRE recommendation. [s2] [s4]
GRE Mathematics [Unresolved]
Not required in the legal checklist; no specific Mathematics Subject Test policy, score threshold, consideration
weight or upload prohibition established. Generic old FAQ GRE language does not resolve the subject-test
category. [s2] [s4]

Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Upload academic CV, record of all previous university examinations/grades, degree evidence if already
awarded, master’s thesis or abstract, and ID. Italian-university certificates are replaced by self-certification
under the call; confirm the appropriate official foreign-record format for UChicago. FAQ accepts university
documents in English, French, Spanish or German. [s2] [s4]
Mathematics-course list [Unresolved]
All examinations and grades are required; no additional standardized mathematics-only list found. Include
complete academic records and check whether PICA asks further course metadata. [s2]
Course descriptions [Unresolved]
No separate syllabus/course-description packet is requested in the current legal checklist. The
foreign-equivalence inquiry may require additional clarification, but no prescribed format was found. [s2] [s4]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Conflict]
Conflicting public descriptions: current legal call says up to two professors; student wiki says at least one
reference; old FAQ says two. Arrange two professors and ask admissions to confirm the mandatory 2027
minimum. No basis to treat zero letters as safe. [s2] [s4] [s6]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
Ordinary SISSA fellowship consideration is integrated with admission, without a separate scholarship
referee/essay in the legal call. External project awards may differ; inspect their own conditions. [s2] [s3]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Legal call places referee entry after completion/signing of the application; institutional email details then
generate a platform request to upload the recommendation. Merely saving a draft before submission is not
established as an invitation trigger. [s2]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
The current call describes reference requests subsequently to the signed admission request. Submit early
enough to activate them; public instructions do not establish a method to request letters from an unfinished
draft. [s2]
Receipt confirmation [Unresolved]
PICA instructions confirm application delivery/protocol emails, not individual referee receipt. A letter receipt
indicator/email was not established in SISSA’s public guide; verify in the actual portal. [s5]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
The linked PICA guide says submitted applications cannot be edited: withdraw/reapply before the deadline;
draft editing is allowed. It does not specify whether letters transfer, can be replaced or can be reused across
calls. Confirm before withdrawing an application with letters. [s5]
Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Required academic CV, uploaded as non-editable electronic document/PDF. No specific prompt beyond
academic history, page count, font or margin limit in current call. Old FAQ lists 8 MB/file and 20 MB total, but
those limits require 2027 PICA confirmation. [s2] [s4] [s5]
Statement of purpose [Unresolved]
No separate statement of purpose is listed in the current GMP/legal checklist. Do not invent an upload

requirement or assume an unlisted optional essay is accepted. Any 2027 portal-only prompt/limit remains
unverified. [s2] [s3]
Personal / background statement [Unresolved]
No separate personal/background statement found in current legal/GMP requirements; prompt, limit and
upload permission unestablished. [s2] [s3]
Research-interest statement [Unresolved]
Research fit is assessed through qualifications and oral examination; no standalone research-interest
statement is listed. Faculty contact can clarify relevant projects. Any portal text-box prompt/length is not
public. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
No research proposal is requested in the general/GMP 2026 admission lists. A later PhD research project is part
of study, not evidence of a pre-application proposal requirement. Check the 2027 call for changes. [s2] [s3]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
Required master’s thesis OR abstract in non-editable upload/PDF. No abstract word/page limit published. A BA
applicant seeking equivalence must ask whether an undergraduate thesis or research summary is the
accepted substitute. [s2]
Publications list [Unresolved]
No standalone publications-list mandate. Old FAQ permits relevant thesis/poster/other-document uploads, but
current PICA allowance and limits need checking. Describe publications in CV; do not assume papers may be
linked instead of uploaded. [s2] [s4]
Course-list document [Unresolved]
No separate course-list statement requested; all examination records/grades are part of the academic-record
requirement. Template, syllabus attachment and length not published. [s2]
Scholarship essays [Standing rule]
No separate ordinary SISSA scholarship essay; funding accompanies selection. For an externally
sponsored/restricted award, follow its own call, which may impose project-specific material. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Other short answers / materials [Conflict]
Print/sign and re-upload the admission request as directed by the current call/PICA signature method; upload
ID. The linked technical guide requires PDF. Old FAQ’s email/paper procedure is superseded by the current
PICA call. [s2] [s4] [s5]
Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
Prior 2026-27 call: €16,242.96 annually before INPS deductions, for the course duration. Additional benefits:
relocation €1,000 if domiciled outside Europe or €500 in EU; eligible registered Trieste rental €150
gross/month; laptop reimbursement up to €400; eligible health insurance reimbursement up to €700/year;
later-year career-development up to €1,000 and qualifying non-EU home-travel up to €500. These are
conditional benefits, not guaranteed net salary. [s2]
Years of support [Prior cycle]
Four-year PhD and scholarship, with possible completion after year three; annual progression/examinations
condition continuation. 2027-28 terms not yet published. [s2]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
The call expressly welcomes all citizenships; ordinary SISSA awards are not restricted to EU applicants. Non-EU
status may qualify for specified insurance/travel support, subject to the exact rules. Visa/Italian residence steps
are separate from US F-1 status. [s1] [s2]

Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Scholarship is subject to INPS deductions and satisfactory progression; housing supplement requires a
registered rental in Trieste province away from family home. Health/laptop/travel benefits require evidence
and specified eligibility. Prior annual regional student tax €120-€160 is payable for enrolment/funding. [s2]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
No separate general-fellowship application listed beyond PhD competition. Housing, insurance, laptop and
travel reimbursements require their own requests/evidence after admission. [s2]
Other funding routes [Conflict]
Central admission page advertises separately funded project fellowships; no matching additional 2027 GMP call
verified. Old FAQ welcomes external scholarships and describes SISSA top-ups, but its €1,120 net figure is
dated and not a reliable current guarantee. [s1] [s4]
Application fee [Unresolved]
No application fee amount is stated in the checked call/PICA instructions; do not label it free from silence.
Regional enrolment tax is separate: prior €120-€160/year. No 2027 tuition/tax schedule confirmed. [s2] [s5]
Fee waiver [Unresolved]
No application-fee waiver procedure or UChicago/F-1 entitlement found. Regional-tax relief follows ARDIS rules;
a waiver should not be assumed from admission or international status. [s2]
Conflicts and remaining checks
Conflicting sources [Conflict]
Old FAQ retains non-EU March preselection, in-person exams, email/paper submission and lower benefit
amounts; current GMP call uses January selection with remote oral and PICA. Reference minimum is
inconsistent. SISSA still lists Pavlo Gavrylenko as faculty, but Birmingham’s current page and SISSA’s June 2026
event identify him at Birmingham. Ugo Bruzzo is on former-faculty list. [s2] [s3] [s4] [s6] [s7] [s19] [s20] [s21]
Checks still needed [Unresolved]
Confirm UChicago BA equivalence and thesis substitute, actual 2027 call/date, mandatory reference minimum
and exact cutoff hour, letter receipt/reuse, PICA size limits/hidden prompts, fee/waivers, net funding and
acceptance deadline. Ask each PI about 2027 capacity; verify cross-programme supervision for
mathematical-physics collaborators. [s1] [s2] [s4] [s5]
